name: brute_slam_crater
notes: Where the maul lands: a pale grit flash with a 2-frame hit-stop, then a dark crater pit with a broken rubble rim (~1.4 m), four cracks racing out from it, a big dust burst and dust rolling out to both sides (~3 m), heavy rocks flung up that bounce and settle, grit. The crater fades out in blocks at the end. Anchor = the crater centre on the ground. 15 frames @ 12 fps.
